qualityOrderDisplayIssue.problemDescription: String concatenation result being treated as number
qualityOrderDisplayIssue.errorMessage: The value 'Quality Order #: 000016' cannot be converted to a number

solutions.formula: If(IsBlank(ListViewQO.Selected.Title), "No Quality Order Selected", If(IsNumeric(ListViewQO.Selected.Title), "Quality Order #: " & Text(Value(ListViewQO.Selected.Title)), "Quality Order #: " & Text(ListViewQO.Selected.Title)))

preventionGuidelines: Always use Text() for display concatenation
Always use Value() for numeric operations
Validate data types before operations using IsNumeric()
Separate display logic from business logic
Use Coalesce() to handle blank/null values
Test formulas with edge cases including blank, zero, and text values
